texts.preamble: N.Sudhakar vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh on 4 November, 2022 Author: R. Raghunandan Rao Bench: R. Raghunandan Rao Hon'Ble Sri Justice R. Raghunandan Rao Criminal PETITION.No.8717 of 2022 Order:
texts.facts: The petitioner is accused in Crime No.293 of 2022 of Bhogapuram Police Station, Vizianagaram District for offences punishable under Sections 41 and 102 of Cr.P.C. The allegations in the complaint are that the petitioner had been found in possession of chewing tobacco products and that the said tobacco products, along with the vehicle of the petitioner, were seized.
texts.arguments: 3. The police authorities have been registering criminal cases against the persons found to be transporting, possessing or selling tobacco products under various provisions of I.P.C., including Sections 273 and 278 I.P.C., along with the provisions of the Cigarettes And Other Tobacco Products (Prohibition Of Advertisement And Regulation Of Trade And Commerce, Production, Supply And Distribution) Act, 2003, and under the provisions of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
